summary: Single monthly pack; corporate free menu×day mix billed at menu prices; ops partial day confirmation; cutoff locks day edits.

rules.packs: Only one published MealPackage (Monthly Pack). Publishing archives other published packs.
rules.corporate_selection: Any menus + day counts that fill working days; coupon at checkout.
rules.billing: food = Σ(menu.price × day_count × quantity); charges and coupon applied on top.
rules.ops_confirm: assignSchedule accepts 1..N days; schedule_status awaiting_schedule → partially_scheduled → scheduled.
rules.cutoff: Past cutoff dates excluded from confirm UI; pending day swap/skip blocked after OrderCutoff.
